source.note: Devnet deployment; program keypairs and address registry in ~/.config/omnipair/dusk-devnet. Binary attested from chain (upgradeable loader programdata). Re-pinned 2026-09-10 for the harvest authority change: harvest takes a `caller` signer distinct from `owner`, and that caller must be the LP owner or the recipient the owner designated through set_yield_recipient. This lets yield be harvested while hLP sits in an order PDA that cannot sign for itself, without opening the instruction to any signer. The previous binary (91c3ee46c5dda029...) is preserved at dusk-keepers/artifacts/dusk-devnet-91c3ee46.so for rollback. source.worktreeFingerprintSha256 covers programs/ and is reproduced by scripts/compute-worktree-fingerprint.mjs.
